en.headline: Two foreign men arrested in Mong Kok drug syndicate raids
en.dek: Police seized about 7.89 kg of suspected ice and 1.81 kg of suspected heroin worth HK$4.8 million in operations targeting a Kowloon drug syndicate.
body: Officers from the Kowloon West regional crime unit arrested two foreign men in Mong Kok on Monday after raiding two tenement flats under Operations THUNDERBOLT and LEVINGTON, which targeted a drug syndicate active in Kowloon.

Police said a 43-year-old man was arrested outside one flat with about 59 grams of suspected heroin. Inside the flat officers found about 5.89 kilograms of suspected ice, 1.75 kilograms of suspected heroin and drug packaging tools. A 36-year-old man was arrested at a nearby flat with about 2 kilograms of suspected ice.

In total, about 7.89 kilograms of suspected ice and 1.81 kilograms of suspected heroin with an estimated value of about HK$4.8 million were seized. Both men, described as key members of the syndicate, were detained for further investigation.

zh.headline: 旺角掃毒拘兩名外籍男子 檢值480萬元毒品
zh.dek: 警方在旺角兩個唐樓單位檢獲約7.89公斤懷疑冰毒及1.81公斤懷疑海洛英，估計市值約480萬元。
body: 西九龍總區重案組人員星期一在旺角採取「雷霆」及「利文頓」行動，搜查兩個唐樓單位，拘捕兩名外籍男子，行動針對活躍於九龍的販毒集團。
警方表示，一名43歲男子在其中一個單位外被拘捕，身上藏有約59克懷疑海洛英；單位內檢獲約5.89公斤懷疑冰毒、1.75公斤懷疑海洛英及毒品包裝工具。另一名36歲男子在附近單位被拘捕，身上藏有約2公斤懷疑冰毒。
行動合共檢獲約7.89公斤懷疑冰毒及1.81公斤懷疑海洛英，估計市值約480萬港元。兩名男子被指為集團主要成員，現正被扣留調查。
